The '''sonic stunner''' was a weapon that could stun or send a sonic charge that could damage most sentients' ears and [[Brain/Legends|brain]].

==Description==
The sonic stunner fired a concentrated burst of sonic energy using technology similar to [[Geonosian sonic blaster/Legends|Geonosian sonic weapons]]. The sonic burst penetrated to the target's brain, causing great pain. This was likely the reason why it was employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[T0-D interrogation droid]]s. Unlike most other [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], only the target of the sonic stunner heard any noise, making the weapon otherwise silent. This was likely the reason why it was considered illegal to own in all but the most highly regulated circumstances.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />

[[Palandrix Personal Protection Gear]] manufactured such weapons.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

==History==
[[Assassin droid/Legends|Assassin droid]] [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]] was equipped with a sonic stunner.<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] also had his own sonic stunner which he used to stun his [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] or destroy [[Computer/Legends|computers]].

[[Urai Fen]], the second-in-command of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]], was also known to use a sonic stunner.<ref name="FOC prima">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
